About.title: A little grain of happiness
About.intro: Le Petit Grain was born from a simple wish: to bring specialty coffee and artisan baking together in one warm place.
About.story1: Every morning, before dawn, our bakery wakes up. Croissants are laminated by hand with churned butter, and pastries are assembled to order.
About.story2: Our coffee is roasted weekly in small batches: a house blend with notes of cocoa and hazelnut, designed for espresso and milk drinks alike.
About.story3: And because we are in Casablanca, we love mixing French classics with local flavours: msemen, gazelle horns, amlou, orange blossom.
About.value1Text: Leavened doughs, laminated pastry and creams made in-house, no shortcuts.
About.value2Text: Churned butter, 64% chocolate, Moroccan almonds and argan.
About.value3Text: A calm, bright place to take a real break.
About.photo1: Croissant filled with cream and crumble
About.photo2: Espresso served in a dark cup
About.fictional: Le Petit Grain is a fictional brand created for a portfolio project.

Legal.legalText: Le Petit Grain is a FICTIONAL brand created as part of a web development portfolio project. No real sales take place. The addresses, phone numbers and emails shown are fictional. Photographs are used for illustration purposes only.
Legal.privacyText: The details you enter (name, phone, email) are only used to process an order, a booking or a message. They are never sold or used for advertising. The site only uses a technical cookie: your chosen language (and, for the administrator, the login session). Your cart is stored in your browser.
Legal.termsText: Orders are takeaway only, collected in store at the chosen time and paid on the spot (cash or card). Prices are shown in Moroccan dirhams, including taxes, and confirmed when the order is placed. Orders not collected may be cancelled at the end of the day.
